title: Applied Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) Practitioner
description: A 6-week hands-on intelligence pipeline covering OPSEC cleanrooms, advanced search syntax, forensic metadata extraction, geospatial analysis, technical infrastructure mapping, and executive intelligence synthesis.

modules.title: Week 1: OpSec, Digital Hygiene, and the Sock Puppet Cleanroom
Week 2: Search Operators, Dorking, and Wayback Forensics
Week 3: Metadata Extraction (ExifTool) and Document Provenance
Week 4: Geospatial Reconnaissance (GEOINT/IMINT) and Shadow Geometry
Week 5: Technical Infrastructure Recon (DNS, CT Logs, Shodan)
Week 6: Link Analysis Synthesis and the Intelligence Brief
